items.description:
V-Inked Tattoos is a tattoo and piercing studio in Moregloed, Polokwane, working strictly by appointment rather than on a walk-in basis. Its listed services cover tattooing and tattoo removal, together with body piercing and the more specific options of ear and nose piercing. Permanent makeup also appears among its current services, extending the studio's work into longer-lasting cosmetic treatments alongside its ink and piercing offering.

Because every visit is booked ahead, clients can plan a consultation around a particular tattoo design, a piercing, a removal session or a permanent makeup appointment without competing for a walk-in slot. This suits people who want dedicated time with the studio for a specific piece of work, whether they are getting a first tattoo or returning for further piercing. V-Inked Tattoos is based at 96 Betz Street in Moregloed, serving Polokwane residents looking for tattoo, piercing and related cosmetic services from one appointment-only studio.

VLEISLAPA is a butcher shop at 24 Grobler Street in Polokwane Central, focused specifically on meat and butchery products rather than a wider grocery range. As a dedicated butchery, it serves local consumers looking for everyday cuts and other meat products from a single Polokwane Central address.

The shop trades Monday through Saturday, giving customers a consistent window through the working week and into the weekend to plan a visit, while closing on Sundays. Standing on Grobler Street in the heart of Polokwane Central, VLEISLAPA is within easy reach of other shoppers and businesses in the area, making it a convenient stop for households and individuals wanting a dedicated butcher rather than a supermarket meat counter.

Westenburg Secondary School is a public secondary school in Westenburg, Polokwane, providing secondary education to learners from the local community. According to the school's own website, it was established in 1984 and officially opened in 1985, giving it a history stretching back more than four decades in the area.

As a public institution, the school draws its learners mainly from Westenburg and the neighbouring parts of Polokwane, offering local families a nearby option for their children's secondary schooling rather than requiring travel further into the city. It serves secondary-school learners moving on from primary school in the surrounding community, continuing the role it has played since opening in the mid-1980s. Westenburg Secondary School is located at 57 Ben Harris Street, Westenburg, within reach of the households it has long served.

77 On Burger is a serviced accommodation apartment in Hospital Park, Polokwane, available as a spacious three-bedroom, two-bathroom unit rather than a single hotel room. The apartment comes with its own kitchen or kitchenette, free Wi-Fi and air-conditioning, giving guests the facilities to settle in much as they would at home. A private parking space and a balcony are also part of the unit, adding convenience for guests arriving by car and space to relax outdoors.

This self-catering setup suits travellers wanting more room and independence than a standard hotel stay, including families, groups and business travellers staying in Polokwane for several days. The listing has built up hundreds of guest reviews over time, reflecting a steady flow of visitors who have chosen it as a base. 77 On Burger is located at 77B Burger Street in Hospital Park, within easy reach of central Polokwane for guests visiting or staying in the city.

Abundance City Church is a Christian congregation meeting at 2 Myngenoegen, Dalmada AH, Polokwane. The church holds a Sunday morning service and a shorter midweek service, giving its congregation two opportunities each week to attend worship rather than a single weekly gathering.

Beyond its regular services, the church runs small groups and community outreach activities that extend its work beyond Sunday mornings, bringing members together outside the main services and connecting with the wider community around Dalmada. It serves members of the Christian community in and around Polokwane, as well as newcomers attending a service for the first time. Abundance City Church is based in Dalmada AH, Polokwane, offering a local church home for residents of the surrounding area.

Alf Makaleng Primary School is a public primary school in Seshego, Polokwane, offering education from Grade R through to Grade 7 under the national CAPS curriculum. As a no-fee, Quintile 3 school in the Capricorn South district, it charges no tuition fees, making it accessible to families across the surrounding community.

The school is a sizeable one for the area, with roughly 1,400 to 1,500 learners taught by about 35 to 36 educators, a scale that reflects its role as a major primary school serving Seshego rather than a small neighbourhood institution. It serves primary-school-aged children from Seshego and the surrounding communities, following the standard admissions process set out for South African public schools. Alf Makaleng Primary School is based in Seshego, within reach of the families it has educated over the years.

The Apple Tree Creche & Pre School is an early-childhood care and preschool facility at 109 Pietersburg Street in Annadale, Polokwane. It looks after young children during the working week, combining daycare with preschool education for children not yet old enough for formal schooling.

The creche opens early and stays open late, trading on weekdays from 06:30 to 17:00, a schedule built around the working hours of parents who need care for their children both before and after a typical working day. It serves families in Annadale and the surrounding Polokwane suburbs who need reliable daycare alongside early learning for their young children. The Apple Tree Creche & Pre School offers a local option for parents wanting both childcare and an introduction to early education in one place.

Beauty Cafe Cycad Centre is a hair, nail, lash and skin treatment salon at Shop 22, Cycad Centre, 114 General Maritz Street in Bendor Park, Polokwane. The salon offers hair cutting and styling, facials, massages, waxing, manicures and pedicures, and makeup application, covering most everyday beauty and grooming needs under one roof.

Its own website lists brands including Dermalogica, Schwarzkopf, Moroccan Oil, Bio Sculpture and RapidLash among the products used and sold in the salon, pointing to a focus on established, professional-grade beauty ranges rather than generic stock. Beauty Cafe Cycad Centre serves women and men of different ages looking for grooming and self-care services, from a quick manicure to a full facial or styling session. The salon trades from Bendor Park's Cycad Centre, giving Polokwane clients a dedicated beauty destination in a convenient shopping location.

Checkers Liquor at Mall of the North trades as the dedicated liquor store alongside the main Checkers supermarket in the mall, based in Shop L37 in Bendor, Polokwane. As a liquor retailer, it stocks wine, beer and spirits for adult shoppers rather than groceries, operating as a separate, specialised store within the same complex.

The store's current trading hours, confirmed on the mall's own store directory, give shoppers a reliable window to stop in for alcoholic beverages while visiting Mall of the North across the week and over weekends. It serves adult consumers in Bendor and the wider Polokwane area who want a focused liquor selection without browsing a full supermarket aisle for it. Checkers Liquor sits within the Mall of the North complex on the R81 in Bendor, making it an easy add-on stop for shoppers already at the mall.

Checkers Mall of the North is a full-service supermarket at Shop L36 in Mall of the North, on the junction of the N1 and R81 in Bendor, Polokwane. Confirmed through the mall's own current store directory, the supermarket stocks groceries, fresh produce, a bakery and household goods, covering a weekly shop rather than a narrower product range.

A September 2026 catalogue listing shows Checkers Mall of the North still running its usual specials, a detail that points to the branch remaining open and actively trading rather than having closed or changed hands. Shoppers from Bendor and the wider Mall of the North catchment use the supermarket for everyday grocery and household needs alongside their other shopping at the mall. The branch forms part of the mall's anchor tenants, giving Polokwane shoppers a full grocery stop within the same complex as its other stores.

Clicks Thornhill is a pharmacy and retail health, beauty and personal-care store inside Thornhill Shopping Centre, on the corner of Munnik Avenue and Veldspaat Street in Thornhill, Polokwane. As a branch of the Clicks pharmacy chain, confirmed on the retailer's own official store page, it combines a dispensary with a wide retail range covering skincare, haircare, makeup, baby care and everyday household essentials.

Shoppers can fill prescriptions and pick up over-the-counter medicines on the same visit as general health, beauty and personal-care shopping, making the store a practical single stop for both. It serves residents of Thornhill Estate and nearby Polokwane suburbs needing pharmacy services alongside everyday retail products, from toiletries to healthcare basics. Clicks Thornhill's position inside Thornhill Shopping Centre places it close to the centre's other stores, making it an easy addition to a regular shopping trip.

Debonairs Pizza Turfloop Plaza serves pizza and chicken meals for collection and delivery from Shop E1 in Turfloop Plaza on University Road, Mankweng. As a branch of the national Debonairs Pizza chain, it offers the brand's usual range alongside sides, built for sharing or a quick meal on the go.

Customers can order online for delivery, collect in person, or walk in for a quick bite, giving Mankweng, Turfloop and University of Limpopo customers more than one way to get a meal from the branch. The store trades daily from 09:00 to 21:00, giving a consistent window for lunch, dinner or a late-evening order throughout the week. Debonairs Pizza Turfloop Plaza is a convenient option for students, staff and residents around Mankweng and Turfloop looking for takeaway or delivered pizza and chicken.

Exilamanzi is a plumbing, electrical and air-conditioning contractor based at 16 Korinda, Acacia Estate, in Bendor, Polokwane. The company's own website advertises round-the-clock customer support and emergency assistance, alongside its core trades of installing, repairing and maintaining plumbing systems, electrical components and air-conditioning units for homes and businesses.

Beyond routine installation and repair work, Exilamanzi offers technical assistance for ongoing problems and emergency maintenance for issues such as burst pipes or electrical faults that cannot wait for a scheduled visit, with help also available on quotations for larger projects. It serves residential and business property owners across Bendor and the wider Polokwane area who need a single contractor for plumbing, electrical or air-conditioning work rather than hiring separate specialists. Exilamanzi's base in Acacia Estate, Bendor, puts it within reach of both homeowners and businesses needing technical or maintenance support.

Fair Price is a furniture, appliance and electronics retailer trading from Shop 25/26 in Paledi Mall, Turfloop Township, in Mankweng. It is categorised as a furniture dealer and runs branch-specific catalogue specials, part of a retail group founded in 1999 that also operates branches across the wider Polokwane region, including outlets in Seshego, at Zebediela Plaza, Lebowakgomo, Mokopane and Bochum, alongside two further branches in central Polokwane.

The Mankweng branch publishes its own monthly catalogue of specials on furniture, appliances and electronics, giving shoppers in the area access to the same promotional pricing available across the group's other stores in Limpopo.

Trading from Paledi Mall, the store serves residents of Mankweng and the surrounding Turfloop Township looking for household furniture, appliances and electronics within easy reach of the University of Limpopo area.

John Craig – Mall@Lebo is a branch of the South African menswear retailer John Craig, confirmed by Mall@Lebo's own store directory as trading from Shop 42. The chain sells men's clothing, footwear and accessories, with footwear ranges spanning sneakers, formal shoes, boots and sandals alongside clothing, seasonal new arrivals and accessories, and it stocks recognised brands such as Polo through its shop-by-brand ranges.

As part of a national retail group, the Lebowakgomo store gives shoppers access to the same current ranges, new-season arrivals and brand partnerships offered across John Craig's wider store network, rather than a stand-alone local stock selection.

Trading from Shop 42 in Mall@Lebo, the store serves men in and around Lebowakgomo shopping for footwear, clothing and accessories from established South African and international menswear brands.

Lepelle-Nkumpi Local Municipality is the local government authority responsible for administering the Lepelle-Nkumpi municipal area, part of the Capricorn District Municipality in Limpopo. Its work is organised into sections covering background and demographics, municipal services, investment opportunities, and the area's agriculture, mining, tourism and industry sectors under its local economic development programme.

The municipality is governed through a council structure, with an organisational structure setting out how its administration is run and services are delivered. As a public administrative body rather than a trading business, it is accountable to the residents, businesses and organisations within its area of jurisdiction rather than to paying customers.

Its administrative offices are based at the Civic Centre in Lebowakgomo, from where it coordinates municipal services, investment facilitation and governance for the Lepelle-Nkumpi area and the communities within it.

Patients attending any of the practices based there visit a single, centrally located building rather than separate stand-alone consulting rooms spread across the city centre.

Current listing information for the building shows it operating on weekdays, giving patients a predictable window in which to reach the practitioners working from the premises during the working week.

Situated on Grobler Street in Polokwane Central, Medical Chambers serves as a convenient, central point of reference for patients attending medical appointments in the city centre, bringing several practices together under one roof.

OK Furniture Mall@Lebo is the Lebowakgomo branch of the national furniture and homeware retailer OK Furniture, listed in the Home & Furniture category and confirmed at Shop 30 in Mall@Lebo's own store directory. The branch trades near other Mall@Lebo anchors such as Clicks, Fair Price and Build It, and runs its own catalogue of monthly furniture and homeware deals and promotions alongside the rest of the OK Furniture chain.

As part of a long-established national retail group, the branch gives shoppers in Lebowakgomo access to the same furniture and homeware ranges and promotional pricing carried across OK Furniture's wider store network.

Trading from Shop 30 in Mall@Lebo, the store serves residents of Lebowakgomo and the surrounding area looking to furnish or equip a home without travelling further afield.

PEP Home – Mall@Lebo is the homeware and décor arm of the PEP retail chain, confirmed by Mall@Lebo's own store directory as trading from Shop 43, alongside the separate PEP clothing and PEP Cell outlets elsewhere in the same centre. The store stocks home textiles, décor items and household goods as part of PEP's affordable homeware range.

Trading alongside anchors such as Pick n Pay, Clicks and OK Furniture within Mall@Lebo, the branch gives shoppers access to the same affordable homeware ranges carried across PEP Home's wider store network, rather than a stand-alone local selection.

From Shop 43 in Mall@Lebo, the store serves residents of Lebowakgomo and the surrounding area shopping for affordable home textiles, décor and household goods.

Alpha Sand & Stone is a building materials supplier and plant hire business at 40 Railway Street in Annadale, Polokwane, operating since 1971. It supplies sand and stone for building work, including builder's mix for econo-concrete, river sand for concrete mixes and paving bedding, building sand for mortar, and plaster sand for plastering. The company says all its sand is screened before delivery, though it may still contain small organic material.

The business also offers plant hire, with TLB machines fitted with optional auger or hydraulic hammer attachments, excavators, front-end loaders, articulated dump trucks, dozers, graders and a mobile jaw crusher. Abnormal lowbed transport is part of the service, which helps contractors move heavy machinery around the region. Builders and contractors can source both materials and machinery from one supplier.

Classy Creations is a precast walling and concrete business in Ladanna, Polokwane, based at 5 Yster Street. It produces precast walls, concrete palisades and steel palisades, and it supplies fencing alongside custom-moulded concrete security products. Where a precast wall is too low for its purpose, the company can raise it with its Classy Crete system once the wall has been erected.

The business serves owners who need boundary walls, security fencing or a higher wall on an existing property. Its directory listing places it among the concrete factories in Polokwane, and the company's own site gives details of its products. Anyone planning a boundary or security project can use the website to find out what the company supplies.

Christ Baptist Church is an English-speaking, multi-ethnic Baptist congregation in Flora Park, Polokwane, meeting at 375 Marshall Street. It was established as Pietersburg Baptist Church and has served the city since 1961. The church describes its aim as exalting, equipping and evangelising, and it runs ministries for different age groups.

The women's ministry meets weekly at a house on Thabo Mbeki Street, and Faith Builders runs on Sunday mornings during school terms. Young adults can join the Discern ministry, which includes university and college students as well as young working singles. A creche takes children aged two to six during Sunday morning worship, and the church also offers children's, youth and growth group ministries.

Eva Clothing is a women's fashion store at 81 Market Street in Polokwane Central, selling dresses, sets, tops, accessories and shoes. The range includes African print and Ankara dresses, animal-print maxi dresses and sequinned cocktail dresses. Among the listed items, prices run from R180 to R280.

Shoppers can buy from the online store or visit the shop in person, and the business offers nationwide courier delivery for online orders. The Instagram account has listed sizes from 28 to 38, and customers can contact the team on WhatsApp for product details and stock questions. Eva Clothing suits women looking for dresses and traditional wear in a range of sizes.

Ko'Thabeng Guesthouse is a self-catering guesthouse at 1855A Ko'Thabeng Street in Bester, Lebowakgomo. It offers three-bedroom units with private kitchens, lounges and TVs. The listing describes recently renovated family rooms with air-conditioning and private bathrooms, and some rooms have garden or mountain views.

Free Wi-Fi and free parking are included, which makes the guesthouse a practical base for visitors to Lebowakgomo and the wider Limpopo area. Online guest reviews score the property 7.7 out of 10 from 89 reviews, with cleanliness and staff among its highest scores. The layout suits families and groups travelling together, and the guesthouse sits on Ko'Thabeng Street in Bester, within the Lebowakgomo area.

McDonald's Baobab Gardens is a fast-food restaurant on Aloe Vera Street in Baobab Gardens, Thornhill Estate, Polokwane. The branch has a drive-thru service alongside the national menu of breakfast, chicken, beef and vegetarian burgers, salads, McCafé drinks, desserts and shakes. Happy Meals, extra value meals and sides are also on the menu, and drive-thru customers can order without leaving their vehicle.

Customers can order for collection or delivery through a delivery partner, and the branch can be reached through the McDonald's customer care line. Its position in Baobab Gardens makes it a convenient stop for drivers and residents of the Thornhill Estate area who want a quick meal.

Mugg & Bean Savannah Mall is a coffee shop and restaurant at Shop G7 in Savannah Mall, on the corner of Thabo Mbeki and Grimm Street in Fauna Park, Polokwane. The restaurant serves freshly brewed coffee, bottomless drinks, all-day breakfast, brunch and lunch, along with muffins and cakes made from scratch. Guests can dine in, collect takeaway or order online.

The branch is part of the Mugg & Bean chain and has a rewards programme for regular customers. Its menu is built around bottomless coffee and classic breakfasts, which makes it a practical choice for shoppers who want a sit-down meal while visiting the mall. The full menu is available on the chain's website.

Panarottis Mall of the North is an Italian restaurant in Shop U73 at Mall of the North on the R81 in Bendor, Polokwane, serving pizzas and pastas as part of the national Panarottis chain. The restaurant says its food is made from quality ingredients, and the menu includes dishes such as Alfredo pasta and Margherita pizza. It suits families, and this branch lists a play area for children.

The branch also lists Wi-Fi access, disabled facilities, halaal options, a smoking area and a liquor licence, and it is listed as load-shedding safe. Its location inside the Mall of the North complex makes it a convenient place for shoppers in Bendor to stop for a meal.

Peoples Church is an Assembly of God congregation at 80 Oost Street in Moregloed, Polokwane, focused on helping people grow a relationship with Jesus Christ. The church holds a weekend service on Sundays and a midweek service on Wednesdays. It also runs life groups, baby blessings and prayer ministry, and it offers an online option for those who cannot attend in person.

New visitors can follow the church's Starting Point process, a four-step path covering following, connecting, discovering and serving. Next steps include water baptism and membership, and the church has a guest welcome for people who are new to faith. The church describes itself as touching lives and changing tomorrow.
